value.rationale: This is the complete exact entropy, escape-rate and symbolic zeta phase diagram for the first depth-three binary-cylinder, two-phase leaking system, a natural next-memory moving-hole model of constant hole size. Six distinct spectral levels and their exact population distinguish schedules not ordered by hole motion alone. Two static-vs-alternating complementary schedules have identical complete periodic-orbit data, while first-two-return orbit counts are provably inadequate and exactly three are sufficient. The full, motivated finite classification and sharp horizon have mathematical use as benchmarks for time-dependent open dynamics; no general formula for arbitrary hole depths is claimed.
